description: This Java source file implements the InterestRateChartReadPlatformService interface. It provides methods to retrieve, process, and map interest rate chart data from a relational database using JDBC. The class manages querying interest rate charts, slabs, incentives, and related metadata from various database tables, constructing data representations to be used elsewhere in the application. It includes nested classes for mapping database result sets to domain objects, handling complex SQL schema and extraction logic.
